question.text: A distributor empanelled with a Category III AIF can:

answer.text: Be empanelled only with one AIF
Be empanelled with MORE than one AIF

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.2.6, a distributor CAN be empanelled with more than one Category III AIF. **The Trap:** Single-empanelment or individual-only restrictions are incorrect. **Cross-Exam Context:** Common practice across MF and AIF distribution. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Disclose all empanelments to clients to manage conflict of interest.
